units: <cite ref="Tosefta Shabbat 9:20">Tosef. Sabb. IX</cite> (<cite ref="Tosefta Shabbat 10:20">X</cite>), 20; <cite ref="Shabbat 74b:7">Sabb. 74ᵇ</cite> <he>והמוֹרְטוֹ</he> and he who plucks the down off the large feather of the wing.

<cite ref="Bava Metzia 68b:7">B. Mets. 68ᵇ</cite> <he>גוזזות ושוטפות ומוֹרְטוֹת</he> (Ar. <he>גזוזות</he>) they yield wool by being shorn, by passing through water, and by being plucked (in passing bushes &c.; [prob. to be read <he>גזוזות ושטופות ומְרוּטוֹת</he>].

Naz. 39ᵇ תלש מ׳ סיפסף וכ׳ if he pinced his hair (near the root), plucked it off, or trimmed it &c.; (Ar. s. v. ספסף: ‘created a bald spot by using a depilatory’). Sabb. l. c. מְמָרֵט חייב משום ממחק he who plucks the down (v. supra) is guilty of an act coming under the head of scraping (leather).—Part. pass. מְמוֹרָט bald-headed.

<cite ref="Nazir 46b">Naz. 46ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Yoma 61b:5">Yoma 61ᵇ</cite> <he>נזיר ממ׳</he>; <cite ref="Tosefta Nazir 1:6">Tosef. Naz. I, 6</cite> <he>המוֹרָט</he>; Y. ib. VI, end, 55ᵈ <he>נזיר ומירט</he> (read: <he>נזיר ממ׳</he> or <cite ref="M00637"><he>מורט</he></cite>).
<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 12">Num. R. s. 12</cite> <he>נחשת ממורט</he> (prob. to be read: <he>מְמוֹרֶטֶת</he>) polished bronze.

senses.gloss: to be plucked, to be bald. Sifra Thazr., Par. 5, ch. X נ׳ ראשו וכ׳ if his head became bald through sickness.
